remarks: This well located 3-bedroom ranch offers true one-floor living with a modern, renovated interior. The home has been updated, featuring a brand-new kitchen, an updated bathroom, and gorgeous new flooring throughout. The thoughtful layout boasts an extra-large living room with a built-in workspace alcove, plus a charming dining nook. Unwind in the primary bedroom, which serves as a peaceful evening retreat, catching beautiful twilight colors through its expansive windows.  The exterior features fantastic outdoor living spaces, including a welcoming front porch perfect for morning coffee, a large lawn with seasonal blooms, a BBQ area, and a dedicated backyard fire pit. Car enthusiasts, hobbyists, or short-term rental hosts needing an owner's lockup will love the impressively large detached garage.  Situated in an incredible lakeside neighborhood, you are just steps from the water.  Less than a minute down the road to Porter on the Lake Park for premium beach access, swimming, and relaxing.  Owner occupants will love the area and Porter Schools while investors can capitalize on a fully furnished, proven, income-generating asset.  Owner is a licensed real estate broker.
